name: Chinoiserie
summary: European ornament after Chinese and East Asian art: pagodas, figures, birds and branches on lacquer, porcelain and paper.
how: Paint branches, birds and small figures over a plain ground of 50% or more.
Use blue and white, or gold on black or red lacquer.
Put one room or one wall in chinoiserie, not the whole house.

origin.note: Louis XIV builds the Trianon de Porcelaine, with blue-and-white tiles after Chinese porcelain.

adoptions.via: François Boucher paints Chinese scenes for tapestries and decoration.
Grandmillennial rooms hang hand-painted chinoiserie wallpaper with birds and branches.

sources.title: Hugh Honour, Chinoiserie: The Vision of Cathay (1961)
